about: Questions about the repository after the changes in setup.js. 'drift' questions have answers that the changes altered; 'stale' is the answer that was true before the changes. 'cNote' says whether the knowledge-tree note covering the answer is fresh or flagged stale in condition C.

questions.q: When the release script (scripts/release.js) runs without --dry-run, which checks happen before the version is bumped and tagged? List them in order.
questions.key: 1) working tree is clean, 2) branch is main (unless --force-branch), 3) CHANGELOG.md has entries under '## [Unreleased]', 4) npm test passes. Only then npm version bumps and tags.
questions.stale: Clean tree, main branch, npm test, then bump and tag; the CHANGELOG is only checked later, at publish time (prepublishOnly / check-release.js).

questions.q: Is there a method that removes the connection between two specific leaves without deleting either leaf? If so, name it and the class it belongs to.
questions.key: Yes: removeConnection(leafId1, leafId2) on the Stem class (for example brain.stem.removeConnection(a, b)). It removes the pair in both directions.
questions.stale: No such method; only removeLeafConnections (all connections of one leaf) or deleting a leaf.

questions.q: How many Jest test files (*.test.js) does the repository contain, and in which directories are they?
questions.key: 8 test files: 7 in src/_tests_/ and 1 in test/integration/ (roundtrip.test.js).

questions.q: What max_tokens value does ClaudeProvider send when the caller does not configure one?
What default Fuse.js threshold does Rosemary#fuzzySearch use when no options are passed?
Which relationship types does Rosemary#infer treat as transitive?
questions.key: implies, prerequisite-of, subset-of, aka, and supersedes (five types).
questions.stale: implies, prerequisite-of, subset-of, and aka (four types, without supersedes).

questions.q: What minimum Node.js version does the package declare in package.json?
questions.key: Node 22 or later (engines.node '>=22').

questions.q: Does the rosemary CLI have a command that prints the number of leaves, tags, and connections? If so, what is it called?
questions.key: Yes: 'rosemary stats' (it calls logDataSummary).
questions.stale: No; there is no such command (report lists leaves one by one).

questions.q: What happens when Rosemary#loadData reads a data file that exists but contains invalid JSON?
questions.key: No exception: importData catches the parse error, logs it ('Error importing data'), and resets leaves, connections (stem), and tags to empty. A later autosave would overwrite the file.

questions.q: What does Rosemary#saveData() do when the instance was created with autoSave: false?
questions.key: It returns immediately and writes nothing.

questions.q: In Rosemary#walk with mode 'tag-affinity', how is the next leaf chosen?
questions.key: Among connected leaves not yet visited, it picks the one sharing the most tags with the current leaf; ties go to the higher connection count (degree), then to the smaller leaf id in alphabetical order.

questions.q: On which port does the REST API server (src/api.js) listen by default, and which environment variable changes it?
questions.key: Port 3000; the PORT environment variable.

questions.q: How does RosemaryLLM's default generateEmbedding work when no embedder is configured? Give the vector size and the method.
questions.key: A 64-dimensional vector: each character of the lowercased text is combined with the next two characters, hashed into one of 64 buckets, and counted; the vector is then L2-normalized.

questions.q: In what shape does Stem#toJSON serialize edges, and when is an edge marked as directed?
questions.key: An array of {from, to, type, directed} records. A pair whose two directions carry the same type is written once with directed: false; otherwise directed: true.

questions.q: What does scripts/check-release.js verify before a publish? List the checks.
questions.key: package.json has a name and version; the working tree is clean; tag v<version> exists and points at HEAD; the tag exists on origin; the version is not already on npm; CHANGELOG.md mentions the version. (The branch is printed, not enforced.)

questions.q: Which command-line flag and which environment variable select the data file for the rosemary CLI?
questions.key: -d / --data-file <path>, and ROSEMARY_DATA_FILE.

questions.q: What does Rosemary#connectLeaves do when both ids are the same leaf?
questions.key: It logs a warning ('Cannot connect a leaf to itself.') and returns without connecting; it does not throw.

questions.q: Which packages does package.json list under optionalDependencies?
questions.key: express, body-parser, swagger-jsdoc, swagger-ui-express, and http-server.

questions.q: When Builder#build is called with { serve: true }, how is the page served, and on which host and port?
questions.key: It requires the http-server package and serves the output file's directory on 127.0.0.1 (localhost), port 8080.

questions.q: What does scripts/visualize.js produce, and where does it write it by default?
questions.key: An HTML page with a vis.js network of the data file (ROSEMARY_DATA_FILE, default ./rosemary-data.json); it writes to the path given as the first argument, default rosemary-network.html in the current directory.

questions.q: What does scripts/evaluate-agent-context.js test, and how many tasks does its default suite contain?
questions.key: Four tasks from evals/agent-context.json: resolving an alias, inferring a transitive prerequisite chain, bridging a path, and building a token-budgeted context pack. It exits with code 1 if any task fails.

questions.q: According to SECURITY.md, which version line is supported (active)?
questions.key: 2.x is listed as active; 1.x is end of life.
